items.text: General tab — layer toolbar and section cards fuse into one general-tab-surface card (classic, modern, and glass).
Theme tab (B10) — colors toolbar and palettes share theme-colors-tab-surface; unsaved state uses the shared save-mode pill and tab dot instead of a local badge.
GET /version — JSON endpoint with Docker VERSION / COMMIT build metadata for deploy checks.
Static cache headers — versioned /static/ URLs (?v=) cache for one year; other assets get a one-day public max-age.
Request logging — structured access logs with X-Request-ID (skips /static/ and /locales/).
P1 hardening — CORS allowlist, in-memory preview cache, health report TTL, structured backup/import logs, and graceful shutdown on SIGTERM/SIGINT.
